tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

file_path.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

new_string.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

replace_all.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.description: Request cancellation of one agent's current turn inside THIS session scope. Foreign-scope targets are refused with zero reach; the request rides the runtime's own cancel leg and never settles cancellation itself.

agent_id.description: Target agent id inside this scope (or this scope's own `scope:id` form).

reason.description: Optional short reason recorded with the request.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List the subagents this session started (its own subagent catalog). Read-only enumeration: it declares no mutation effect and reaches no spawn, steer, or interrupt face of the runtime.

scope.description: children (default) lists your direct children only; descendants walks the complete tree below you.

tools.name: list_subagent_models
tools.description: List the LLM providers/models advertised to this mount, optionally filtered by provider. Read-only enumeration of the route catalogue; it declares no mutation effect and spawns nothing.

provider.description: Exact provider id to inspect; omit to list providers.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command`) inside this member's admitted working root. Prefer PowerShell syntax (`Get-ChildItem`, `$env:NAME`, backtick continuation); multi-line scripts are supported. The command runs under the mount's confined provider: filesystem writes land only inside the admitted working root. Foreground only — a timed-out command is terminated, never promoted to a background job.

command.description: the PowerShell command text, run as `pwsh -Command <command>` (one argv element — no shell-quoting layer)

description.description: a short description of what the command does (1 sentence, states why it is needed)

workdir.description: working directory inside the governed working root (default: the root itself)

timeoutMs.description: kill the command after this many milliseconds (the row terminates a timed-out payload; the exit code is reported as not-observed)

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

file_path.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

offset.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: read_image
tools.description: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF file and return the image itself. Large images are downscaled automatically; do not install image libraries or create thumbnails to inspect an image.

file_path.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send one message to another agent inside THIS session scope. Targets outside the caller's own scope are refused before any runtime is reached; the call is admission-gated and its execution identity is one-shot (a settled call never re-delivers).

agent_id.description: Target agent id inside this scope (or this scope's own `scope:id` form).

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a governed subagent. The spawn is admission-gated before any agent is created, stays bounded by the CALLER's own authority (no privilege amplification), and every child is recorded on the mount's own scope.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task.

prompt.description: The complete, self-contained task for the subagent.

provider.description: LLM provider route for the child; must sit inside the caller's own authority.

model.description: Model id for the child; must sit inside the caller's own authority.

reasoning_effort.description: Adapter-owned reasoning effort for the child route.

run_in_background.description: Whether the child runs in the background.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.description: Delegate a task to a governed child that inherits this conversation as DATA. Inherited context is never inherited authority: the child carries no grants, approvals, or permissions from the parent, and the spawn stays bounded by the caller's own authority.

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task.

prompt.description: The task for the child; it already sees this conversation's completed turns.

run_in_background.description: Whether the child runs in the background.

tools.name: team_bash
tools.description: Governed shell (a5p5 lane): opaque command text decided by admission + the confined backend; deny-before-backend.

tools.name: team_glob
tools.description: Governed filename traversal (a5p5 lane): pattern + target ONLY; admission-gated before any backend runs.

tools.name: team_grep
tools.description: Governed search (a5p5 lane): strict pattern search over the realm; effects derived read-time, admission-gated before any backend runs.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description: Run a governed orchestration script whose agent legs execute through the caller-bound runtime delegates: every spawn re-passes the no-amplification fence and every steer re-passes the owner fence, so a workflow carries exactly THIS call's authority — never more.

description.description: A short description of the orchestration.

prompt.description: The closed orchestration request handed to the governed runtime.
